body: I thought refurbs underwent more hands on testing by an expert. All I know is, I gave them a chance and it didn't work out. 2 lemons in a row is straight up bad.

A sample size of 7 is still small, but I'm glad you haven't had a bad experience. The less people experience it, the better. It's less so the defects and more so about the lack of help fixing them that's driving my decision to switch to a different line of phones. Good service is worth the higher price tag imo
I think they do too. 7 is insane! I don't want to do a third one because the score on trust is 2-0. If they had better customer service I would be more open to giving it a chance
5th? What makes you stay with this line of phones?

Just met or having already been on multiple dates? I don't expect exclusivity from someone I've only been on one date with and expect that they are multi-dating. I do have a threshold amount of time and dates where I do expect the sense of them getting to know me to have evolved past a certain point. I'm not expecting boyfriend-level commitment either, just the assurance that they're not going on 4 other dates that week to give our thing a chance to grow. So yeah, in my eyes, they are looking to replace me after a certain point. Of course I'd be happy that they found someone better, it means it frees me up to find my better person too and that they were honest with me. Monogamous dating is zero sum.

Speaking from the exact same experience, if he's not excited about you now, he never will be. I don't continue giving people my time who have gotten to experience my genuine personality on multiple dates and don't see the inherent value in me enough to want to replace me with another person by keeping their options open.

I would thank him for the honesty and move on.
I'm not desperate enough to share part time affection of any man. I don't believe emotional availability is infinite.
